Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Calumet County’s county seat as Appleton. Appleton is the seat of Outagamie County (and extends into Calumet and Winnebago), while Calumet County’s actual seat is Chilton. This misattribution resulted from failing to verify the county seat before concluding, conflating Appleton’s cross-county presence with Calumet’s seat.
